page.layout: Running head at top centre. One main column of text, with year numbers 1260 to 1266 in the left margin beside it. Fragments of italic text in the right margin at the top and at mid-height. A line of foot text at lower right, under the column.; One printed page, cut off in its left part. Marginal notes in the right margin: a block of five lines at the top, and a block of three lines lower down.

note.i: Ius negotiandi Angliam ab rico III rege cĩ[?] ii Croning. per as confirmatum.

page.notes: Right-margin fragments at the top and at mid-height are partial and italic; "cum" and "conj" are visible at mid-height on the right, with the fragment after "per Hen vita liter" marked [?]. The year numbers beside the column are attached to the first line of each group. The "Germanicè" and "Latinè" accents and the "vulgo" accent are uncertain. The long s in "sæculo" is read from a form with no crossbar. The main text of this page is not visible in this part of the scan. The marginal notes are transcribed as seen. "Fanum" and the first letter of "summatum" are doubtful. The "Ada" of "Adoardianum" and the "Croning" are read as printed; the abbreviation over "ci" is doubtful.
